gold.title: Gwyn, Lord of Cinder
gold.snippet: Gwyn proved himself a skilled ruler, using his power to bind and hold close to him the potential powers of the world. He amply rewarded the betrayal of the dragon Seath and his indispensable contribution to the war, giving him the title of Duke and inducting him into the nobility of the gods through a marriage to one of his daughters. Gwyn also gave him a fragment of his powerful Lord Soul along with the Archives, and left him to his studies near Anor Londo. As for humans, cognizant of the abilities of four of their great leaders, Gwyn bequeathed on them another shard of his powerful Soul, and let them build their civilization of New Londo near the divine capital. Manus at one point kidnapped Princess Dusk of Oolacile and imprisoned her deep within the Chasm of the Abyss. His prized pendant eventually came under the possession of a Chosen Undead in the future; Manus, driven by his unrelenting search for his pendant, snatched the Undead from the future and brought them into the old Oolacile. There, the Chosen Undead encountered Knight Artorias, who had retained only the very last vestige of his sanity in the battle against the Abyss, still desperate to put down the corrupted creatures of Oolacile. During the fight that ensued between him and the Chosen Undead, Artorias succumbed to the Abyss entirely, and was finally defeated by the Undead.

gold.title: Lords
gold.snippet: Darkstalker Kaathe, who opposed Gwyn's actions, attempted to bring about the Age of Dark and the coming of its ruler, the Dark Lord; most travelling to Oolacile and manipulating the citizens into upturning the grave of "primordial man". This resulted in Oolacile's fall as it began to be swallowed by the Abyss, consuming the land and corrupting its citizens. Kaathe also went to New Londo, seducing the Four Kings with the art of lifedrain, which corrupted them and their knights. In an effort to contain his darkwraiths, New Londo was flooded -an act that ultimately cost the lives of the city's inhabitants.

The king was forced to hire mercenaries from Forossa and Volgen to reinforce his ranks, and Desert Sorceresses from Jugo were added to the defense of the Royal Castle. Those who could afford it ran away to other countries while the poor were left without a place to sleep, the kingdom now reduced to ruins. contrast.title: Ashen One
contrast.snippet:
Ashen One -  Dark Souls III - character - lead 
 lead : The **Ashen One,** also referred to as the **Champion of Ash** or **the Unkindled One,** is the playable character and the protagonist of *Dark Souls III*.

The title of Ashen One is given to the player by the Fire Keeper of Firelink Shrine. The Ashen One is an Unkindled, an Undead who failed to link the First Flame and became ash, who has been raised from their grave, and is tasked with a journey to defeat four Lords of Cinder and return them to their thrones, since the link of the Flame is threatened and the Lords refuse to serve as its fuel once again.

While the name of the "Wolf Knight" was seemingly lost to history, there were many who swore themselves into a new covenant with the goal of fighting Abyss's abominations. These warriors would come to be known as Farron's Undead Legion, The Abyss Watchers. It was said that the Undead Legion vowed to partake of "wolf blood", binding their souls into one that traced its roots to Artorias, the first Abyss Watcher, in an eternal mandate to hold back the tides of the Abyss. contrast.title: Ashen One
contrast.snippet:
Ashen One -  Dark Souls III - character - lead 
 lead : The **Ashen One,** also referred to as the **Champion of Ash** or **the Unkindled One,** is the playable character and the protagonist of *Dark Souls III*.

The title of Ashen One is given to the player by the Fire Keeper of Firelink Shrine. The Ashen One is an Unkindled, an Undead who failed to link the First Flame and became ash, who has been raised from their grave, and is tasked with a journey to defeat four Lords of Cinder and return them to their thrones, since the link of the Flame is threatened and the Lords refuse to serve as its fuel once again.

From there, the Ashen One proceeds to the Kiln of the First Flame.

Over time Friede earned their trust, to the point that the Corvian Knights who protected the village became infatuated with her; above all, she managed to get close to Father Ariandel, a Great Corvian who had the task of guarding the Flame within the Painted World and to burn it when the painting began to rot. gold.title: Demon (lore)
gold.snippet: Alsanna, as the heiress to her Lord's wishes and in reverence of the apocalypse, devoted herself and the power of her Dark Soul to a ritual in the hopes of appeasing the raging flame. With the ivory gates opened, the land of Eleum Loyce grew cold and lifeless, turning into a frigid expanse, in an attempt to freeze Chaos along with the entire country. The remaining Knights of Eleum Loyce remained to watch over the Garrison Ward under the King's final orders to contain the Chaos, waiting patiently for a new leader strong enough to guide them into its depths, while Alsanna remained in prayer inside the Cathedral over the depths to continue the ritual. The Old Chaos was thus contained, albeit it

contrast.title: Frozen Eleum Loyce
contrast.snippet:
In addition the Ivory King was served by seven beasts infused with wondrous souls and each of them were conferred a specific duty. Aava became the guardian of Alsanna as the King's beloved child while Lud and Zallen were tasked with the mercy killing of exiles

However the flames of Chaos would not be sated and the Ivory King was forced to use the power of his own soul to keep it at bay. Over time he was drained of his vigour and when he sensed the degradation of his power he decided to plunge into Chaos' heart in an attempt to reduce its flames alone. He decided to leave without a word to his subjects and left everything to Alsanna who had now found her place at his side, conferring a sword

gold.title: Seath the Scaleless
gold.snippet: At some point, the Four Lords who had found immense Lord Souls and built their civilizations underground emerged to the surface with the intention of waging war against the Dragons and conquering the world for themselves. Seath decided to betray his race to ally with Gwyn, Lord of Sunlight, and help the Lords in the war. He was instrumental in the gods' eventual victory, and the triumphant Lords would exterminate much of the Ancient Dragons, cementing their rule. Seath would also pillage the Ancient Dragons' sacred treasure, the Primordial Crystal, the centerpiece of his efforts to achieve immortality.

contrast.title: Primordial Serpents
contrast.snippet:
Kaathe resides in the darkness of the Abyss, but seems to be more involved in the affairs of Lordran than Frampt. Kaathe gave the Four Kings the art of lifedrain and consequently founded the Darkwraith covenant. He also seems to have tricked the residents of Oolacile into uncovering the corpse of Manus, driving him mad in the process. This sparked the spread of the Abyss, transforming the townsfolk into monstrous beings whose humanity has run wild, akin to Manus.

In the ending of Dark Lord, ten additional primordial serpents are seen, whose names are unknown. They appear to want to serve the newly-appointed Dark Lord, and possibly usher in the Age of Dark. An interesting note in this ending

Abyss -  Dark Souls - location - location 
 location : In Dark Souls the Abyss is located at the end of the New Londo Ruins. To reach to the Abyss, the floodgates must be lowered and the Covenant of Artorias ring, a reward for killing Great Grey Wolf Sif, must be worn. After climbing down a spiral staircase within a tower, the path will abruptly end, making it necessary to descend into the darkness of the Abyss.

The DLC *Artorias of the Abyss* allows us to explore a more recent Abyss, despite being located in a past era, deep within the dungeons of Oolacile.

gold.title: The Nameless King
gold.snippet: The eldest son of Gwyn eventually decided to "sacrifice everything" to ally himself with the dragons. In the eyes of the other deities of Anor Londo, archenemies of the dragons, his actions amounted to an unforgivable sin; he was therefore dethroned and exiled from the city. The former king was deprived of his deific status, his statues destroyed and his name erased from the annals of history. Before leaving Anor Londo, the eldest left his sunlight blade miracle and ring on Gwyn's empty tomb in his mausoleum as a final farewell, still paying respects for his father. Now excommunicated from the pantheon of the gods and without a home, the god of war continued to watch closely over his warrior

contrast.title: Eygil
contrast.snippet: If this were true, then the sins that the Lost Sinner constantly punishes herself for could include the aforemantiond creation of the Smelter Demon, mirroring the Witch of Izalith's own conceit leading to the creation of the demon race. Why Eygil would be imprisoned in the Lost Bastille, a place belonging to the rival kingdom of Venn, is unclear, though the Old Iron King may have conquered it just as he conquered the land where Brume Tower was erected. Alternatively, they may have just captured and imprisoned the magus when the king perished and his kingdom fell.

gold.title: Humans
gold.snippet: On their quest, the Ashen One encounters the Painted World of Ariandel, and a little girl whose duty it is to become the new Painter, and replace it with a fresh, unrotted version. To do this, she reveals that she needs the blood of the bearer of the Dark Soul, and that her guardian Gael has gone to find it. At the end of time, as the flames are reduced to embers and sparks, the entire world has begun to collapse in on itself, surrounding the ageless Ringed City. Gael travels to this heap of reality to find the Dark Soul, with the Ashen One following suit, eventually slaying Argo, the leader of the Spears of the Church.
